title: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
title_zh: 非加性固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？
title_primary: 非加性固定效应模型的识别：教师质量的回报是同质的吗？
title_secondary: Identification of non-additive fixed effects models: Is the return to teacher quality homogeneous?
authors: Jinyong Hahn, John D. Singleton, Neşe Yıldız
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Panel or grouped data are often used to allow for unobserved individual heterogeneity in econometric models via fixed effects. In this paper, we discuss identification of a panel data model in which the unobserved heterogeneity both enters additively and interacts with treatment variables. We present identification and estimation methods for parameters of interest in this model under both strict and weak exogeneity assumptions. The key identification insight is that other periods’ treatment variables are instruments for the unobserved fixed effects. We apply our proposed estimator to matched student-teacher data used to estimate value-added models of teacher quality. We show that the common assumption that the return to teacher quality is the same for all students is rejected by the data. We also present evidence that No Child Left Behind-era school accountability raised the effectiveness of teacher quality for lower performing students.

title: Platform-Wide Agreements and Competition for New Users
title_zh: 平台范围协议与新用户竞争
title_primary: 平台范围协议与新用户竞争
title_secondary: Platform-Wide Agreements and Competition for New Users
authors: Peter Boberg, Martino De Stefano, Keler Marku, Mary Beth Savio
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a bargaining model where a distributor allocates new users between an incumbent supplier, which also serves an installed base, and a rival. We compare separable agreements, whereby installed-base payments continue regardless of the new-user award, with platform-wide agreements, whereby those payments are made only if the incumbent receives the award. When installed-base users are inframarginal and bargaining is frictionless, the contractual linkage does not affect supplier selection or the rival’s equilibrium payment: the distributor’s lost payment is exactly offset by the incumbent’s avoided payment. When contracting frictions are present, platform-wide agreements can exclude a more efficient rival.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个议价模型，其中分销商将新用户分配给一个既服务现有客户群的在位供应商，或其竞争对手。我们比较了可分离协议与平台范围协议，前者无论新用户归属如何，现有客户群的支付都持续进行；后者仅在位供应商获得新用户分配时才进行这些支付。当现有客户群用户处于边际内且议价无摩擦时，合同关联不影响供应商选择或竞争对手的均衡支付：分销商损失的支付恰好由在位供应商避免的支付所抵消。当存在合同摩擦时，平台范围协议可能排除更高效的竞争对手。

title: Tariff shocks and land sales: Evidence from China’s cities
title_zh: 关税冲击与土地出让：来自中国城市的证据
title_primary: 关税冲击与土地出让：来自中国城市的证据
title_secondary: Tariff shocks and land sales: Evidence from China’s cities
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies whether local governments use land sales to buffer trade shocks. Combining land transactions for 275 Chinese cities over 2015–2023 with a Bartik measure of US tariff exposure, we find that more exposed cities raise land-sale revenue after the US-China trade war through higher average prices rather than greater aggregate land area. The price increase reflects two channels: a shift toward high-grade land driven primarily by area expansion, and a within-use price increase in commercial-residential land with no corresponding area response. Mechanism analysis shows that tariff shocks weaken local economic activity and intensify fiscal pressure.
abstract_zh: 本文研究地方政府是否利用土地出让来缓冲贸易冲击。结合2015至2023年间中国275个城市的土地交易数据与美国关税暴露的Bartik度量，我们发现，在中美贸易战后，暴露程度更高的城市通过提高平均地价而非扩大土地出让总面积来增加土地出让收入。地价上涨反映了两条渠道：一是主要由面积扩张驱动的高等级土地占比提升，二是商业住宅用地内部价格上升而面积并无相应响应。机制分析表明，关税冲击削弱了地方经济活动并加剧了财政压力。

title: Strategic alliances and outward foreign direct investment decisions
title_zh: 战略联盟与对外直接投资决策
title_primary: 战略联盟与对外直接投资决策
title_secondary: Strategic alliances and outward foreign direct investment decisions
authors: Xiuzhen Li, Yutong Wang, Yueng Wah Khong, Yun Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how strategic alliance formation influences corporate outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) decisions based on a sample of Chinese share listed companies, and finds that strategic alliances significantly promote OFDI activities by dual channels of digital transformation and R&D investment, and the promoting effect is more pronounced for firms located within the ‘Top Ten Commercial Group Cultures’ circle, those with high ESG performance, and those with lower agency costs. Analysis of market soft information shows that strategic alliances provide additional impetus for OFDI by analyst coverage and investor optimism.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国A股上市公司样本，探讨了战略联盟形成如何影响企业对外直接投资决策，并发现战略联盟通过数字化转型与研发投入的双重渠道显著促进了对外直接投资活动，且这一促进效应在位于“十大商业集团文化”圈内的企业、具有高ESG表现的企业以及代理成本较低的企业中更为显著。市场软信息分析显示，战略联盟通过分析师关注与投资者乐观情绪为对外直接投资提供了额外动力。

title: SNAP Cycle and Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care
title_zh: SNAP周期与医疗护理中的费用相关延误
title_primary: SNAP周期与医疗护理中的费用相关延误
title_secondary: SNAP Cycle and Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Managing chronic medical conditions requires daily adherence to pharmaceutical regimens, yet low-income families frequently face unstable budget constraints that force immediate spending trade-offs between nutrition and out-of-pocket healthcare costs. This paper explores how the time since benefit receipt of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) affects healthcare access for low-income families managing chronic medical conditions. Empirical estimation reveals significant fluctuations in medication use, particularly during Days 20–23, when benefits are nearly exhausted. We observe a unique dual-peak pattern in medication use: an initial spike right after benefits are received (Days 0–3) due to immediate shopping disruptions, followed by a sharp increase in medication rationing around three weeks later, driven by liquidity constraints. We also identify sub-population heterogeneity based on benefit adequacy and food insecurity. Low-allotment households exhibit a 23 percentage point increase in medication non-adherence early in the cycle (Days 8–11) compared to those with higher allotments. Conversely, while high-allotment households remain stable early on, their adherence rates decline significantly by the third week, indicating depleted financial buffers. These results suggest that improving SNAP benefit amounts and adjusting issuance frequency could enhance medication adherence and alleviate healthcare access challenges for vulnerable families.
abstract_zh: 管理慢性疾病需要每日坚持用药方案，然而低收入家庭常常面临不稳定的预算约束，迫使他们在营养与自付医疗费用之间做出即时的支出权衡。本文探讨了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）福利领取后的时间长度如何影响管理慢性疾病的低收入家庭的医疗可及性。实证估计揭示了药物使用的显著波动，尤其是在福利即将耗尽时的第20至23天。我们观察到药物使用中一种独特的双峰模式：福利领取后立即出现初始峰值（第0至3天），源于即时的购物中断效应；随后约三周后，受流动性约束驱动，药物配给现象急剧增加。我们还基于福利充足性和食品不安全状况识别出亚群体异质性。低配额家庭在周期早期（第8至11天）的药物不依从率比高配额家庭高出23个百分点。相反，高配额家庭在早期保持稳定，但其依从率在第三周显著下降，表明财务缓冲已耗尽。这些结果表明，提高SNAP福利金额并调整发放频率可以增强药物依从性，并缓解弱势家庭面临的医疗可及性挑战。

title: Realized Illiquidity
title_zh: 实现非流动性
title_primary: 实现非流动性
title_secondary: Realized Illiquidity
authors: Demetrio Lacava, Angelo Ranaldo, Paolo Santucci de Magistris
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a simple theory of realized illiquidity, defined as the ratio of realized volatility to trading volume. Building on the widely used price impact measure of Amihud (2002), we introduce the realized Amihud, which significantly improves measurement accuracy. Our theoretical and numerical results show that it robustly captures cumulative intraday price sensitivity to trading, accounting for stochastic volatility, microstructure noise, and information jumps. Empirically, we uncover distinct time-series patterns in realized stock illiquidity—heterogeneous clustering, leverage effects—and show that it predicts short-term returns. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [SNSF Grant 182303]. P. Santucci de Magistris also acknowledges the research support of the Project 2 Grant of the Danish Council for Independent Research (IRFD), Social Sciences, No. 8019-00015A, and of the European Union’s - Next Generation EU program through the Italian PRIN 2022 -M4C2, Investment 1.1 - “Monitoring Risks in Financial Markets” – Codice Cineca: 2022NEL482 - CUP: I53D23003410008. D. Lacava acknowledges that part of this research was carried out while he was affiliated with Luiss University, within the project “Financial Modeling under Non-Gaussian Distributions”. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02505 .
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于已实现非流动性的简洁理论，将其定义为已实现波动率与交易量的比率。基于Amihud（2002）广泛使用的价格冲击度量，我们引入了已实现Amihud指标，显著提升了测量精度。我们的理论和数值结果表明，该指标稳健地捕捉了日内价格对交易的累积敏感性，同时考虑了随机波动率、微观结构噪声和信息跳跃。在实证方面，我们揭示了已实现股票非流动性的独特时间序列模式——异质性聚类、杠杆效应——并展示了其对短期收益的预测能力。本文由Agostino Capponi（金融领域）接受。资金支持：A. Ranaldo感谢瑞士国家科学基金会的资助[项目编号182303]。P. title: Overconfidence and Financial Behavior in Online Betting Markets
title_zh: 在线博彩市场中的过度自信与金融行为
title_primary: 在线博彩市场中的过度自信与金融行为
title_secondary: Overconfidence and Financial Behavior in Online Betting Markets
authors: Lucas Belleza, Tiago Cavalcanti, Daniel Da Mata
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do bettors misperceive expected returns, and does bringing their beliefs closer to the regulatory benchmark change betting and financial allocation decisions? Using a survey experiment in Brazil, we document that bettors are motivated by financial gain and entertainment and expect to receive approximately R$1.75 for every R$1 wagered, far above the R$0.85 regulatory benchmark. A randomized information treatment lowers bettors’ reported beliefs about expected returns by 28% to 37% but reduces the share of windfall income allocated to betting by only 2.1 percentage points. The treatment has a larger effect on the probability of allocating any money to betting than on the amount allocated among those who continue to bet. A parsimonious model rationalizes these findings: when betting provides substantial direct utility, more accurate beliefs have limited effects on betting expenditure and saving. Still, reducing overconfidence limits expected wealth losses, because overconfident bettors consume more today in anticipation of betting winnings that do not materialize on average. Information disclosure may therefore make beliefs more accurate without substantially reducing betting expenditure.
abstract_zh: 投注者是否误解了预期回报，而将他们的信念调整至更接近监管基准是否会改变其投注及财务分配决策？通过在巴西进行的一项调查实验，我们发现投注者既受财务收益也受娱乐动机驱动，他们预期每投注1雷亚尔能获得约1.75雷亚尔的回报，远高于0.85雷亚尔的监管基准。一项随机信息干预使投注者对预期回报的报告信念降低了28%至37%，但仅将意外之财收入中用于投注的比例减少了2.1个百分点。该干预对是否将任何资金用于投注的概率影响大于对继续投注者投注金额的影响。一个简约模型合理化了这些发现：当投注提供大量直接效用时，更准确的信念对投注支出和储蓄的影响有限。尽管如此，减少过度自信限制了预期财富损失，因为过度自信的投注者预期到平均而言不会实现的投注收益，从而在当前消费更多。因此，信息披露可能使信念更加准确，而不会大幅减少投注支出。

title: Internal information asymmetry, external reporting, and insider trading: Theory and evidence
title_zh: 内部信息不对称、外部报告与内幕交易：理论与证据
title_primary: 内部信息不对称、外部报告与内幕交易：理论与证据
title_secondary: Internal information asymmetry, external reporting, and insider trading: Theory and evidence
authors: Chang-Mo Kang, Donghyun Kim, Youngdeok Lim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how enhanced reporting mandates influence insider trading in the presence of information asymmetry among corporate insiders. We develop an insider trading model in which headquarters executives (HQEXs) are less informed about divisional profitability than divisional managers (DMs) and release public reports subject to external auditing. Our model shows that, when insiders have incentives to report optimistically, enhanced reporting mandates can promote DMs' share purchases based on information not shared with HQEXs. We provide supporting evidence from difference-in-differences analyses using a regulatory shock to segment reporting obligations, namely the adoption of SFAS 131. Our study offers new insights for policymakers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在企业内部人之间存在信息不对称的情况下，加强报告要求如何影响内幕交易。我们构建了一个内幕交易模型，其中总部高管（HQEXs）对部门盈利能力的了解程度低于部门经理（DMs），并且发布需经外部审计的公开报告。我们的模型表明，当内部人有动机进行乐观报告时，加强报告要求可以促进部门经理基于未与总部高管共享的信息进行股票购买。我们利用分部报告义务的监管冲击，即SFAS 131的采纳，通过双重差分分析提供了支持性证据。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了新的见解。

title: Heterogeneous Firing Costs, Worker Types, and Productivity: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
title_zh: 异质性解雇成本、工人类型与生产率：来自自然实验的证据
title_primary: 异质性解雇成本、工人类型与生产率：来自自然实验的证据
title_secondary: Heterogeneous Firing Costs, Worker Types, and Productivity: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
authors: Caggese, Andrea, Güler, Ozan, Mariathasan, Mike, Mulier, Klaas
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We investigate how firing costs affect input choices and total factor productivity (TFP) by exploiting a labor reform in Belgium that increased firing costs of blue-collar workers relative to white-collar workers. Using a difference-in-differences design, we show that hiring and separations at blue-collar-intensive firms declined by 8 percent after the reform relative to white-collar-intensive firms. Moreover, blue-collar-intensive firms shifted workforce composition toward white-collar workers, offered fewer permanent contracts, and relied more on outsourced labor. We find no evidence of capital-intensive technology adoption and only little evidence of human capital investment. Ultimately, blue-collar-intensive firms experienced a 4.8 percent decline in TFP.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用比利时一项劳动改革，该改革提高了蓝领工人相对于白领工人的解雇成本，来研究解雇成本如何影响投入选择及全要素生产率（TFP）。采用双重差分设计，我们发现改革后，相对于白领密集型公司，蓝领密集型公司的招聘和离职率下降了8%。此外，蓝领密集型公司调整了劳动力结构，转向更多使用白领工人，提供更少的永久合同，并更多依赖外包劳动力。我们没有发现资本密集型技术采纳的证据，人力资本投资的证据也较少。最终，蓝领密集型公司的全要素生产率下降了4.8%。

title: Retail price responses to a temporary tax holiday: evidence from Uruguay’s water emergency
title_zh: 临时税收假期对零售价格的反应：来自乌拉圭水危机的证据
title_primary: 临时税收假期对零售价格的反应：来自乌拉圭水危机的证据
title_secondary: Retail price responses to a temporary tax holiday: evidence from Uruguay’s water emergency
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We exploit a natural experiment in Uruguay to estimate tax pass-through and test for asymmetric price adjustment. In June 2023, the government eliminated VAT (22%) and excise taxes on bottled water in response to an unprecedented drought emergency. Both taxes were reinstated two months later. The legal perimeter of the exemption covered mineral waters and sodas only, so flavored waters—sold on the same shelf by the same firms—remained fully taxed, providing a sharp within-category placebo and an unusually tight control group. Using weekly price data from a large supermarket chain, we find price responses broadly consistent with full tax pass-through and symmetric adjustment in magnitude, with estimated pass-through rates of approximately 106% at the tax cut and 112% at the reinstatement. Pass-through is uniform across container sizes. Flavored waters exhibit no price response at either transition, and using them as the sole control group reproduces the baseline estimates. Data from precios.uy , a mandatory price-reporting platform covering 634 retailers, show that full and symmetric pass-through extends to the market at large; the speed of adjustment, however, differed across transitions, with an immediate and universal price cut but a staggered price increase.
abstract_zh: 我们利用乌拉圭的一项自然实验来估算税收传导效应并检验价格调整的非对称性。2023年6月，为应对前所未有的干旱紧急状况，政府取消了瓶装水的增值税（22%）和消费税。两个月后，这两项税收重新恢复。免税的法律范围仅涵盖矿泉水和苏打水，因此调味水——由同一企业销售、摆放在同一货架——仍保持全额征税，这提供了一个精准的品类内安慰剂对照组和异常紧密的控制组。利用一家大型连锁超市的周度价格数据，我们发现价格反应大致符合完全税收传导和幅度对称调整的特征，估算的税收传导率在减税时约为106%，在恢复征税时约为112%。传导率在不同容器规格间保持一致。调味水在两个政策转变节点均未表现出价格反应，且将其作为唯一控制组时，基准估计结果得以复现。来自强制性价格报告平台precios.uy（覆盖634家零售商）的数据显示，完全且对称的传导效应扩展至整个市场；然而，调整速度在不同政策转变间存在差异：减税时价格立即且普遍下降，而恢复征税时价格则呈现阶梯式上涨。

title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验
title_primary: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.
abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。

title: The effects of a large energy price shock on bank credit

official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study investigates the effect of the large shock to energy prices following the Russian invasion of Ukraine on bank credit to firms. To isolate the causal effect of the shock, it compares bank lending to high-energy-intensive firms to that of similar low-energy-intensive firms. Following the shock, bank credit to high-energy-intensive firms persistently declined, while their interest rates on new loans rose and other loan terms tightened. Across the distribution, safer firms reduced outstanding credit lines and paid unchanged interest rates on new bank loans, while riskier firms borrowed at higher interest rates. JEL Classification: G21, G32, Q43
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了俄乌冲突后能源价格大幅冲击对企业银行信贷的影响。为隔离该冲击的因果效应，本文对比了银行对高能耗企业与类似低能耗企业的贷款情况。冲击发生后，银行对高能耗企业的信贷持续下降，同时其新增贷款利率上升，其他贷款条件收紧。从分布特征来看，风险较低的企业减少了未偿信贷额度，且新增银行贷款利率保持不变；而风险较高的企业则以更高利率借款。JEL分类号：G21, G32, Q43

abstract: Market thinness can be an important determinant of the riskiness of stock returns, because it reduces the reliability of stock prices as predictors of future dividends. This paper analyses the relationship between market size and risk as the outcome of rational expectations equilibrium in a multiasset model with transaction costs, and shows that: (i) the conditional and measured variance of stock returns should be higher for thin issues ceteris paribus, and (ii) this thinness-variability relationship should arise only from the unsystematic component of the variance. These predictions are tested on data from the Milan Stock Exchange and appear to be supported by the evidence.
abstract_zh: 市场流动性不足可能是股票收益风险性的重要决定因素，因为它降低了股票价格作为未来股息预测指标的可靠性。本文通过构建包含交易成本的多资产模型，将市场规模与风险的关系分析为理性预期均衡的结果，并表明：（i）在其他条件相同的情况下，流动性较差的股票其条件方差与已实现方差应更高；（ii）这种流动性-波动性关系应仅源于方差的非系统性成分。这些预测在米兰证券交易所的数据中得到检验，且实证结果支持上述结论。

title: Cheap Energy Might Not Be Enough: A Trade Model of AI Compute Services
title_zh: 廉价能源可能不够：人工智能计算服务的贸易模型
title_primary: 廉价能源可能不够：人工智能计算服务的贸易模型

source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Can energy-rich developing countries convert cheap electricity into AI compute exports? This paper develops a capacity-constrained trade model of AI compute services with bilateral frictions in delivery, regulation, and trust. Calibrating the model across 85 countries shows that several developing economies can produce compute at low cost, but this advantage rarely becomes export competitiveness. Because hardware dominates unit costs and is globally priced, cross-country production costs differ by only 12–20 percent. Modest regulatory, financing, and trust frictions can therefore erase the gains from cheap power. The binding constraint is institutional credibility rather than electricity prices, including enforceable data governance, stable regulation, credible power contracts, access to finance, and geopolitical alignment with buyers.
abstract_zh: 能源丰富的发展中国家能否将廉价电力转化为人工智能算力出口？本文构建了一个受容量约束的人工智能算力服务贸易模型，该模型纳入了交付、监管和信任方面的双边摩擦。通过对85个国家的模型校准发现，部分发展中经济体能够以低成本生产算力，但这种优势很少能转化为出口竞争力。由于硬件成本在单位成本中占主导地位且具有全球统一定价特征，各国间生产成本差异仅为12%-20%。因此，适度的监管、融资和信任摩擦足以抵消廉价电力带来的收益。制约发展的关键因素并非电价，而是制度可信度，包括可执行的数据治理、稳定的监管环境、可靠的电力合同、融资渠道以及与买方的地缘政治协调。

title: DP519 Dynamic Seigniorage Theory: An Exploration
title_zh: 动态铸币税理论：一项探索
title_primary: 动态铸币税理论：一项探索
title_secondary: DP519 Dynamic Seigniorage Theory: An Exploration
authors: Maurice Obstfeld, Alvaro Delgado-Vega, Barton Lee, Stijn Claessens, Thomas Glaessner 等
official: 官方在线 1991-03-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of seigniorage in which economies' equilibrium paths reflect the ongoing strategic interaction between an optimizing government and a rational public. The model extends existing positive models of monetary policy and inflation by explicitly incorporating the intertemporal linkages among budget deficits, debt and inflation. A central finding is that the public's rational responses to government policies may well create incentives for the government to reduce inflation and the public debt over time. A sufficiently myopic government may, however, provoke a rising equilibrium path of inflation and public debt.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个铸币税的动态模型，其中经济体的均衡路径反映了最优化政府与理性公众之间持续的策略互动。该模型通过明确纳入预算赤字、债务与通胀之间的跨期关联，拓展了现有的货币政策和通胀实证模型。核心发现是：公众对政府政策的理性反应很可能随时间推移为政府创造降低通胀和公共债务的激励。然而，一个足够短视的政府可能引发通胀与公共债务不断攀升的均衡路径。

title: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance
title_zh: 天气冲击对企业经济绩效的异质性影响
title_primary: 天气冲击对企业经济绩效的异质性影响
title_secondary: Heterogeneous effects of weather shocks on firm economic performance
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damages estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于温度冲击对欧洲企业造成经济损失的新型企业层面估计。我采用面板数据分析，揭示了温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这种异质性取决于企业特征。本文揭示了微观数据在量化气候损害估计中的重要性，因为温度与经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这既创造了赢家也创造了输家，损害了生产率较低的企业（尤其是位于较暖地区的企业），同时使生产率较高的企业受益。与合并边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业受到的负面效应大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业获得的正面效应大约是其三倍。我强调了气候变化的分配效应，并为适应政策提供了见解。

title: Protecting the environment: On the interplay between voluntary contributions and public policy
title_zh: 保护环境：论自愿贡献与公共政策的相互作用
title_primary: 保护环境：论自愿贡献与公共政策的相互作用
title_secondary: Protecting the environment: On the interplay between voluntary contributions and public policy
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the interplay between individuals’ voluntary contributions to environmental protection and public environmental policy in a dynamic general-equilibrium model. To capture the observed discrepancy between the willingness of individuals to contribute privately versus publicly to environmental protection, we treat the quality of the environment as a public good and assume that voluntary contributions are motivated by a ‘warm glow’ of giving. We show that in the laissez-faire scenario without government intervention, the strength of warm glow negatively affects aggregate output and positively affects environmental quality in the long run. However, when the government intervenes and decides on environmental policy in the interests of individuals, the warm-glow strength has a negative long-run effect on both variables. Thus, our results suggest that advocating for private actions to ensure a better environment in the future may be counterproductive in the presence of public environmental policies.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个动态一般均衡模型中研究个体对环境保护的自愿贡献与公共环境政策之间的相互作用。为捕捉个体在私下与公开场合对环境保护贡献意愿的差异，我们将环境质量视为公共品，并假设自愿贡献源于“温暖光辉”的利他动机。研究表明：在无政府干预的自由放任情景下，长期中温暖光辉强度会抑制总产出但提升环境质量；然而当政府以个体利益为出发点制定环境政策时，温暖光辉强度对这两个变量均产生长期负面影响。因此，我们的结论表明，在存在公共环境政策的情况下，倡导通过私人行动确保未来环境改善可能适得其反。

title: Who Pays for Unions?
title_zh: 谁为工会买单？
title_primary: 谁为工会买单？
title_secondary: Who Pays for Unions?
authors: Samuel Dodini, Anna Stansbury, Alexander Willén
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less-attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses–and therefore who ultimately bears the cost-depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.
abstract_zh: 摘要 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收抵扣政策的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变动来源，对企业在工会化程度提高时的应对措施进行了全面评估。在私营企业平均层面，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，导致企业收缩就业与生产规模，在降低利润的同时并未提升劳动收入份额。成本负担由多方共同承担：消费者通过更高价格承担部分成本，股东通过更低利润承担部分成本，其余部分则被生产率提升所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失集中于依附性较弱的“局外人”工人。企业应对措施随市场竞争程度呈现系统性差异。在制造业中，由于企业面临竞争程度较低的产品与劳动力市场，其应对模式截然相反：平均而言企业会扩大就业与生产规模，降低劳动力市场议价能力，且未出现利润下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过提价转嫁给消费者，其余部分被生产率提升所抵消。工人因工资与就业同步增长而受益。这些模式表明，工会能够抵消雇主的买方垄断势力，而企业应对措施——以及最终的成本承担者——在很大程度上取决于市场结构。总体而言，该情境下的工会化主要实现从消费者向工人的再分配而非从股东向工人的再分配，且对不同企业产生显著差异化的影响，包括资源向规模更大、生产率更高的企业重新配置。我们通过一个包含产品市场与劳动力市场势力的工会谈判局部均衡模型对这些模式进行了理论解释。

title: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations
title_zh: 电子商务重塑税收竞争：人口规模与税率呈U型关系
title_primary: 电子商务重塑税收竞争：人口规模与税率呈U型关系
title_secondary: E-commerce Reshapes Tax Competition: U-shaped Tax Rates with Respect to Populations
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how technological advancements in mobility—specifically, the rise of e-commerce—alter the landscape of tax competition. Previous studies typically present a monotonic relationship in which regions with larger populations impose higher tax rates. However, in reality, this relationship does not always hold. We develop a model of commodity tax competition with e-commerce and show that local tax rates can have a non-monotonic relationship with regional populations. To be more precise, when online shopping is available, the relationship between tax rates and population sizes follows a U-shaped curve: the region with the moderate population has the lowest tax rate, while areas with small or large populations set higher tax rates. This U-shaped relationship arises from the dual effects of e-commerce: changing tax bases and intensifying tax competition. This result holds regardless of how widespread e-commerce becomes, illustrating how the availability of virtual mobility reshapes traditional spatial competition.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了移动性技术进步——具体而言，即电子商务的兴起——如何改变税收竞争的格局。以往研究通常呈现一种单调关系，即人口较多的地区设定较高的税率。然而，现实中这种关系并不总是成立。我们构建了一个包含电子商务的商品税收竞争模型，并表明地方税率与地区人口之间可能存在非单调关系。更确切地说，当在线购物可用时，税率与人口规模之间的关系呈U形曲线：人口适中的地区税率最低，而人口较少或较多的地区则设定较高的税率。这种U形关系源于电子商务的双重效应：改变税基和加剧税收竞争。无论电子商务普及程度如何，这一结果均成立，从而展示了虚拟移动性的可得性如何重塑传统空间竞争。

title: Inclusive food systems and market development: Insights from Colombia
title_zh: 包容性粮食体系与市场发展：来自哥伦比亚的启示
title_primary: 包容性粮食体系与市场发展：来自哥伦比亚的启示
title_secondary: Inclusive food systems and market development: Insights from Colombia
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Informal commercialisation of agricultural products is widespread in Colombian food systems. It plays a central role in supporting rural livelihoods and affordable food access, but may limit value creation, create fiscal pressures, and undermine the evidence base for policymaking. This paper examines why small-scale farmers in Colombia rely on informal markets, with particular attention to Afro-Colombian and Indigenous communities. It situates informality within the broader context of rural areas and the structure of the agri-food supply chain. It proposes a characterisation of the main barriers that hinder small-scale farmers’ engagement with formal buyers, drawing on desk research and interviews with government officials, industry stakeholders, community representatives, and academics. It suggests that formal market participation could be facilitated by prioritising the provision of rural public goods, improving data and evidence on informality in food systems, better aligning agricultural policies with producer-financed parafiscal funds, and adopting a demand-driven approach to agricultural policy.
abstract_zh: 农产品非正规商业化在哥伦比亚食品体系中普遍存在。它在支撑农村生计和保障食品可负担性方面发挥着核心作用，但可能限制价值创造、造成财政压力，并削弱政策制定的证据基础。本文探讨了哥伦比亚小农户依赖非正规市场的原因，特别关注非裔哥伦比亚人和原住民社区。研究将非正规性置于农村地区及农业食品供应链结构的更广泛背景下，通过案头研究及对政府官员、行业利益相关者、社区代表和学者的访谈，提出了阻碍小农户与正规买家合作的主要障碍特征。研究表明，通过优先提供农村公共产品、改善食品体系中非正规性的数据与证据、更好地协调农业政策与生产者资助的准财政基金，以及采取需求导向的农业政策方法，可促进正规市场参与。

title: Experimental Auctions with Securities
title_zh: 证券化实验拍卖
title_primary: 证券化实验拍卖
title_secondary: Experimental Auctions with Securities
authors: Zachary Breig, Allan Hernández-Chanto, Declan Hunt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We experimentally implement security-bid auctions, which are used around the world to sell projects that generate large, stochastic future cash flows. Buyers make bids with debt and equity, linking payments to the project’s ex-post revenue. Contrary to the theoretical predictions, we find that debt auctions generate more revenue than equity auctions. This is explained by overbidding in debt auctions. Furthermore, we find that second-price equity auctions generate slightly more surplus than other treatments. We also implement informal auctions and find that buyers use equity more often than theory predicts, and that sellers successfully choose dominant bids.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验实施了担保竞价拍卖，这类拍卖在全球范围内被用于出售产生大规模、随机未来现金流的项目。买家以债务和股权形式出价，将支付与项目的事后收入挂钩。与理论预测相反，我们发现债务拍卖比股权拍卖产生更高的收入。这一现象可通过债务拍卖中的过度出价来解释。此外，我们发现第二价格股权拍卖产生的剩余略高于其他处理方式。我们还实施了非正式拍卖，发现买家使用股权的频率高于理论预测，且卖家成功选择了占优出价。

title: Formalizing microentrepreneurs through targeted tax systems: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 通过目标税制规范微型企业家：来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 通过目标税制规范微型企业家：来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Formalizing microentrepreneurs through targeted tax systems: Evidence from Brazil
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effects of reducing formalization costs by exploiting the introduction of a simplified tax regime for microentrepreneurs in Brazil. Using novel administrative data and industry-level eligibility criteria, we show that a large reduction in entry and compliance costs significantly increased formal firm creation. Despite the increase in formalization, newly formal firms exhibit no growth or earnings gains. We then evaluate the new tax system’s fiscal consequences, showing that the expansion in social security coverage generated costs that exceed the additional tax revenue collected by 2.56 times. These costs arise as microentrepreneurs gain access to subsidized contributory benefits after registering through the system, highlighting the broader social value of bringing microentrepreneurs into the formal sector even in the absence of positive government net revenue or improvements in firm performance.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用巴西为微型企业家引入简化税收制度的机会，研究了降低正规化成本的影响。借助新颖的行政数据和行业层面的资格标准，我们表明，大幅降低进入和合规成本显著增加了正规企业的创立。尽管正规化有所增加，新正规化的企业在增长或收益方面并未展现出改善。随后，我们评估了新税收制度的财政后果，显示社会保障覆盖范围的扩大所产生的成本，是额外征收税收收入的2.56倍。这些成本源于微型企业家在通过该系统注册后获得补贴性缴费福利，这凸显了即使在没有政府净收入为正或企业绩效改善的情况下，将微型企业家纳入正规部门也具有更广泛的社会价值。

title: Monetary financing produces neither high inflation nor miraculous fiscal multipliers
title_zh: 货币融资既不会导致高通胀，也不会产生奇迹般的财政乘数
title_primary: 货币融资既不会导致高通胀，也不会产生奇迹般的财政乘数
title_secondary: Monetary financing produces neither high inflation nor miraculous fiscal multipliers
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I investigate the macroeconomic impact of money-financed fiscal stimuli when they are financed by interest-paying central bank reserves. I do so in New Keynesian models where government bonds and reserves are imperfect substitutes. Despite reducing funding costs for the consolidated government, I analytically show for several models that there is zero impact from money-financed fiscal stimuli on inflation and the real economy (relative to debt-financed stimuli). Afterwards, I relax the conditions behind this ‘irrelevance result’, and show that money-financed fiscal stimuli barely increase inflation and output.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在由付息央行储备融资的情况下，货币融资型财政刺激对宏观经济的影响。我在新凯恩斯模型中展开分析，其中政府债券与储备为不完全替代品。尽管降低了合并政府的融资成本，我通过多个模型的分析表明，货币融资型财政刺激对通胀和实体经济的影响（相对于债务融资型刺激）为零。随后，我放宽了这一“无关性结论”背后的条件，并证明货币融资型财政刺激几乎不会推高通胀和产出。

title: The Rise of the Chinese Communist Party,
title_zh: 中国共产党的崛起
title_primary: 中国共产党的崛起
title_secondary: The Rise of the Chinese Communist Party,
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the rise of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in wartime China. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design and several measures as proxies for the rise of the Party during the Sino-Japanese War (middle- to upper-rank party cadres, grassroots party organization, and guerrilla bases), we find that it grew significantly more in counties occupied by the Japanese Army. However, despite its popularity before the war, the same markers were not statistically significant at that time. We identify two primary channels behind the political ascendancy of the CCP. First, the communists took advantage of the militarily weaker “puppet troops” in charge of administering the loosely held occupied areas. Second, support for the CCP was fueled by a strong anti-Japanese sentiment spurred by war suffering, using civilian casualties and rape cases as proxies for the harm inflicted. Finally, the CCP’s wartime influence persisted after the war: former Japanese Occupied Areas exhibited a significantly higher density of party membership between 1950 and 1980.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国共产党在战时中国的崛起。利用空间断点回归设计，并以多项指标（中高级党员干部、基层党组织及游击根据地）作为党在抗日战争期间崛起的代理变量，我们发现党在日军占领的县域中发展显著更快。然而，尽管战前该党已具声望，但同一指标在战前并不具有统计显著性。我们识别出中共政治崛起的两个主要渠道：首先，共产党利用了负责管理松散占领区的军事上较弱的“伪军”；其次，以平民伤亡和强奸案件作为战争伤害的代理变量，由战争苦难激发的强烈抗日情绪推动了民众对中共的支持。最后，中共的战时影响力在战后持续存在：1950年至1980年间，原日军占领区的党员密度显著更高。

title: Algorithmic collusion under sequential pricing and stochastic costs
title_zh: 序贯定价与随机成本下的算法合谋
title_primary: 序贯定价与随机成本下的算法合谋
title_secondary: Algorithmic collusion under sequential pricing and stochastic costs
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The use of pricing algorithms raises concerns about algorithmic collusion. This paper considers a sequential pricing model where marginal cost fluctuates over time. I find that Q-learning algorithms autonomously collude even under cost uncertainty. Collusion is sustained by strategies that involve reward-punishment schemes. It suggests that cost uncertainty is not an obstacle to autonomous algorithmic collusion.
abstract_zh: 定价算法的使用引发了对算法合谋的担忧。本文考虑了一个边际成本随时间波动的序贯定价模型。我发现，即使在成本不确定的情况下，Q学习算法也会自主合谋。合谋通过涉及奖励-惩罚机制的策略得以维持。这表明，成本不确定性并非自主算法合谋的障碍。

title: Spatial price competition and buyer power in the U.S. beef packing industry
title_zh: 美国牛肉包装行业的空间价格竞争与买方势力
title_primary: 美国牛肉包装行业的空间价格竞争与买方势力
title_secondary: Spatial price competition and buyer power in the U.S. beef packing industry
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a spatially-explicit model of the U.S. beef packing industry to study key questions related to competition in an oligopsony setting. Cattle supplies are modeled at the county level, and packing plants' location, capacity, and ownership are taken as given. Packers procure negotiated cattle by competing in prices in each local (county) market, while accounting for transportation costs and pre-existing contracted supplies (alternative marketing arrangements). The model, calibrated to match observed 2022 data, is solved for the Bertrand–Nash equilibrium prices. The computed markdown in the price packers pay for fed cattle is decomposed into three components: the portion due to the inherent spatial oligopsony power; the amount due to an aspect of market concentration (firms owning multiple plants); and the component due to contracting. We find that markdowns are moderate, about $3.69/cwt or 2.6% of the fed cattle price, on average. About 54% of this markdown is due to the spatial configuration of plants, 40% is due to pre-contracted supplies, and only 6% of the markdown is attributed to multi-plant ownership by firms. Separately from markdowns, capacity constraints are found to lower fed cattle prices by 0.8% on average. Beyond the baseline, simulated counterfactual scenarios highlight specific policy-relevant questions. Markdowns are reasonably robust across counterfactuals, decreasing only modestly when plants operate independently or the use of contracting is limited. Across all counterfactual scenarios, cattle prices per se are most affected by tightening capacity constraints (as arising from a major plant closure or an upward swing in the cattle cycle).
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个空间显式模型，用以研究美国牛肉加工行业在寡头买方垄断情境下的关键竞争问题。牛只供应量在县级层面进行建模，而加工厂的选址、产能及所有权被视为既定条件。加工商通过在各地方（县级）市场中竞争价格来采购协议牛，同时考虑运输成本及预先存在的合同供应（替代营销安排）。该模型经过校准以匹配2022年的观测数据，并求解伯特兰-纳什均衡价格。我们将加工商为育肥牛支付的价格中的计算加价折扣分解为三个组成部分：固有空间寡头买方垄断势力所致的部分；市场集中度（企业拥有多家工厂）所致的部分；以及合同安排所致的部分。研究发现，加价折扣幅度适中，平均约为每英担3.69美元，占育肥牛价格的2.6%。其中，约54%的加价折扣源于工厂的空间布局，40%源于预先合同供应，仅6%归因于企业的多工厂所有权。与加价折扣相独立，产能约束平均使育肥牛价格下降0.8%。在基准情形之外，模拟的反事实情景凸显了特定政策相关问题。加价折扣在各反事实情景中保持相对稳健，仅在工厂独立运营或合同使用受限时略有下降。在所有反事实情景中，牛只价格本身受产能约束收紧的影响最大（如因大型工厂关闭或牛周期上行所致）。

title: Integrating machine behavior into human subject experiments: a user-friendly toolkit and an application to framed prisoner’s dilemmas
title_zh: 将机器行为融入人类被试实验：一个用户友好型工具包及其在框架囚徒困境中的应用
title_primary: 将机器行为融入人类被试实验：一个用户友好型工具包及其在框架囚徒困境中的应用
title_secondary: Integrating machine behavior into human subject experiments: a user-friendly toolkit and an application to framed prisoner’s dilemmas
authors: Engel, Christoph, Großmann, Max Rainer Pascal, Ockenfels 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have the potential to profoundly transform and enrich experimental economic research. We propose a new software framework, “alter_ego”, which makes it easy to design experiments between LLMs and to integrate LLMs into oTree-based experiments with human subjects. Our toolkit is freely available at github.com/mrpg/ego . To illustrate, we run differently framed prisoner’s dilemmas with interacting machines as well as with human-machine interaction. Framing effects in machine-only treatments are strong and similar to those expected from previous human-only experiments, yet less pronounced and qualitatively different if machines interact with human participants.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）具有深刻变革和丰富实验经济学研究的潜力。我们提出了一种新的软件框架"alter_ego"，该框架能够便捷地设计LLMs之间的实验，并将其整合到基于oTree平台、涉及人类被试的实验中。我们的工具包可在github.com/mrpg/ego免费获取。为进行说明，我们通过机器间交互以及人机交互的方式，运行了不同框架设定的囚徒困境实验。在纯机器处理组中，框架效应显著且与以往纯人类实验的预期结果相似；但当机器与人类被试交互时，框架效应则较弱且存在质性差异。

title: Evolutionary advantage of moderate fertility during Ming–Qing China: a unified growth perspective
title_zh: 明清中国适度生育的进化优势：统一增长视角
title_primary: 明清中国适度生育的进化优势：统一增长视角
title_secondary: Evolutionary advantage of moderate fertility during Ming–Qing China: a unified growth perspective
official: 官方在线 2025-04-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using genealogical records of Chinese families from 1300 to 1920, this paper examines how the fundamental wheels of change identified by Unified Growth Theory operated within the Ming–Qing context. It finds that families with moderate fertility were more likely to attain higher levels of education and to experience greater reproductive success across generations, revealing a trade-off between high fertility and long-term lineage outcomes. Employing negative binomial regression and instrumental variable methods, the study shows that a preference for child quality conferred an evolutionary advantage—suggesting that, if this evolutionary pattern was present globally during the epoch of stagnation, it may have been central to the demographic transition and the emergence of modern economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1300年至1920年间中国家族谱系记录，考察统一增长理论所识别的变革基本动力在明清时期的运作机制。研究发现，适度生育水平的家族更可能获得更高教育成就，并在代际间实现更优的繁衍成功，揭示了高生育率与长期宗族发展之间的权衡关系。通过采用负二项回归与工具变量方法，研究表明对子女质量的偏好赋予了进化优势——这意味着，若该进化模式在停滞时代全球范围内普遍存在，则可能对人口转型与现代经济增长的出现具有核心作用。
